# 3 bed semi-detached house for sale

> Horan Estates are proud to present this fantastic family home to the Dublin property market. This beautifully maintained three-bedroom semi-detached residence is ideally located within the highly sought-after Castleland development in North Dublin. The property boasts bright and spacious accommodation throughout, presented in excellent condition and designed with comfortable family living in mind.
